translated_title: DEA Tries to Take Credit for Mexican Operation and Contradicts García Harfuch's Account
original_title: DEA intenta adjudicarse operativo mexicano y contradice la versión de García Harfuch
author: José Shaddai Olvera Torres
outlet: El Chamuco y los Hijos del Averno
meta_description: After a record 16-ton meth seizure in Sinaloa, the DEA cast itself as indispensable; Mexico says its Navy led the operation and Washington only shared intelligence.
